title: Remove Queue folder-rule impact UI
summary: Remove the Queue file-overrides folder-rule impact, save, and management UI from the WebView drawer and stop loading the folder-preview child module.
reason: The Folder rule impact surface still did not provide useful operator behavior, so the requested outcome is to remove it instead of continuing to repair the preview.
behavior_before: The Queue file settings drawer exposed Folder rule impact controls, a Folder scope dropdown, folder-rule save confirmations, and Existing folder rules management.
behavior_after: The Queue file settings drawer keeps only per-file override and route-preview controls; folder-rule preview/manage markup, script loading, frontend POST calls, and styling are absent. Backend routes and contracts are left untouched for compatibility.
manual_validation: DesktopApp/Runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.tooling.test_summary_integrity - passed with pre-existing orphan-summary warning for summaries/app/deleted.py.md
Served WebView at http://127.0.0.1:8765 in the in-app browser - Folder rule text absent, folder-rule controls absent, and fileOverrides.folderPreview.js not loaded
rollback_plan: Restore the folder-preview child module, script include, drawer buttons, folder-rule panels, CSS, frontend route ownership expectations, and the removed focused folder-preview static test.
notes: WebView-only UI removal. It does not change Local API routes, backend command authority, queue mutation, settings persistence, media policy, FFmpeg/subtitle/audio behavior, pending publish drain, source/scratch/output movement, or cleanup behavior. Affected Python scripts: DesktopApp/tests/test_application_facade_web_static.py and DesktopApp/tests/test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py.
